_source: Samsung SM-G736B, ML Kit text-recognition, Latin. Every line at 0.0 degrees bar two, and framed larger than the first shot.

_why_it_matters: A pose check, which nothing else in the corpus provides. The recogniser returned this card differently from one photograph to the next - the logo as one box rather than two, the email line as TWO boxes rather than one, and a space inserted after the '@'. A reading that changes with the camera angle is a reading nobody can trust, and no test covered it before this pair.
